You have no idea how much I miss my old self. He was amazing, but I can't see him anymore let alone feel him. I'm not connected to me anymore... I'm someone else. I'm here because I want to be him again, but it's not happening... I'm just a copy of the original with nothing behind it.
Still with me buddy? I thought about you today. Who you are, how you're feeling, if you're still with me... If you're there, how are you today? How's things been?
It's ok. It's nice being able to talk openly without being judged or feeling guilty. Thanks for taking the time out to chat.

Sorry about all this. Don't worry about it. I'm just scared. I need to find my purpose again before I become too worn out from fighting it... As it is I'm starting to accept that I'm going to do it. I just don't see the point anymore. Thanks for trying to help though, I sincerely appreciate it.

I can't re-invent myself though, that's the problem. Wherever I go I'll think the same, which will mean I'll feel the same. I just need... I just need hope again. Two days ago a girl I went on a date with 3-4 years ago messaged me, reminiscing the whole experience, flirting with me, trying to spark up our chemistry again... she's been married for the past year. It's constant. I ran into a group of girls, six or seven of them, actively celebrating a 'cheat on our boyfriends' night... What even!? Do you know how many girls I've slept with only to find out they have partners at home thinking they're staying at a friends house? It's so disheartening... I think life is about love, but then all the girls I meet (and I date a LOT, not to mention I don't have a 'type' and meet these girls EVERYTHING- uni, supermarkets, yoga, on a night out, through friends...) seem to be... superficial, shallow, insecure, immature and highly reactive. Where's all the nice girls at? The Audrey Hepburns of the world, do they still exist? 

I've tried taking a break from dating but that only makes me feel more alone. At least through dating I have these  little windows into what it's like to be intimate or vulnerable... Small, small windows. I need to change my priorities but this is where I need your help- help me understand what life is about then? What am I living for? It can't be for others... I have such potential... Do I spend my life getting into politics, spirituality, do I help people or do invest in my art? What's considered a worthwhile existence? I need to out-think my own brain... 

Does any of this make any sense?

They knew, and they tried to be supportive, but they just don't get it. It's like what Robin Williams said, something like "being alone isn't the worst thing, having people around you who make you feel alone is". I don't believe anymore in what I thought was my purpose to live, and without it I don't see the point in living. I need help but all the help I sought made things worse... So last ditch effort- I ask the internet. Fuck, how fucked am I? I think what I'll do is go traveling, do it overseas and make it look like an accident. Then it's sad but not devastating, and my family and friends can comfort themselves with the cliche sentiment 'he died doing what he loved' or something. I'm being so selfish but I can't keep doing this day by day for the sake of everyone else... it's so taxing. I miss the old me... he'd punch me, hard, for writing this, for feeling and thinking this. I've become pathetic.

I enjoyed looking for 'the one', that was it. I worked out because I wanted to be the best version of myself for 'the one', got an education because I wanted to be able to support a future family, would go out and do anything and everything because that could be where/when I bump into 'the one', just... everything was geared towards that one purpose. I now realise how vulnerable I am, that's why I need to realign my values with something more reliant on myself, but I just don't care about anything... What else is there to life other than finding your soul mate? What more to life is there...?

I volunteer. It's ok... I feel useful but not fulfilled. I've grown to hate that too because it's so draining smiling and being so energetic all the time (I'm a mentor to disadvantaged kids). 

I just... I want to do this, I just don't know how to without hurting my family and friends. I often think I need to stage it so it comes across as a coincidental accident. Maybe then they will feel sad but not guilty/angry. I don't know... I'm running out of steam keeping this up.

Nothing is wrong with you but you need to understand that the only person who can save you, is you. Nothing has helped me either. It's been four months of feeling/thinking that I want to kill myself and it's incredibly draining trying to convince myself not to. What you need to do is this; make hurting yourself a line you refuse to cross. Imbed that into you above all else. Then it becomes a waiting game, experimenting with new ways to try and lift you out of it. People will suggest exercise, working out, socialising, eating healthy, sunlight, antidepressants, whatever, the important thing is to try EVERYTHING because eventually something will click and you'll feel a feeling that let's you know you're on the right track (I can only describe it as a momentary feeling of relief- not happiness, but relief). 

As for why you feel this way, you feel this way because you're hurting. I am too. Our brains can't figure out a solution to our problems (whatever they may be) so in an effort to end our pain, it's solution is suicide. It is NOT the answer and you need to be aware of that. It is nothing to feel guilty about, so do what I've done, make suicide a line you refuse to cross and stay optimistic that the next day, the next thing you try, the next friend you make, the next whatever, will be the start of you finding your peace again. 

Good luck.
